{{Quote|What? It's a raid! Alert TIE patrols!|The Imperial officer realizing that the station was under attack|<ref name="Squadrons" />}}
A '''strike''' was conducted by the [[New Republic]] on a [[Esseles listening post|listening post]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] above [[Esseles]] in order to bait the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Overseer (Imperial-class)|''Overseer'']] and to stall the Imperial hunt for the [[Nadiri Dockyards]]. The strike was successful, and the listening post was destroyed.<ref name="Squadrons" />
